reference_sql:
SELECT country_code, COUNT(*) AS signups,
       RANK() OVER (ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC) AS signup_rank
FROM signups
GROUP BY country_code
alternatives:
WITH country_signups AS (  -- one row per country with signups
  SELECT country_code, COUNT(*) AS signups
  FROM signups
  GROUP BY country_code
)
SELECT cs.country_code, cs.signups,
       1 + (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM country_signups cs2 WHERE cs2.signups > cs.signups) AS signup_rank
FROM country_signups cs

FROM country_signups
